basic_info.description: Incredible single family home on the border of Monterey Heights and St Francis Wood. Large open plan living space with a chef kitchen that leads out to a sunny deck, perfect for indoor/outdoor California living. Bedrooms are oversized with large closets and plenty of space to fit a king size bed in each + additional furniture. Office/flex space on main floor filled with natural light from windows on 2 sides. Beautiful flat yard with mature trees and birds chirping throughout the day. Garage can fit 2+ cars and additional parking on the parking pad. Garage has expansion potential for the home up to 1000sqft. Quiet street and short distance to lovely West Portal retail and transportation. 5-zone underfloor heating (no cold feet!), electric 240v/50amp electric charging, new roof and the list of upgrades go on. Welcome to paradise!
